# Selected Head child contexts through the last branch Mu

Proof checkpoint: `b9ced29b0`. Verified start: `b517bc5e7`.
Source main: `184bba662`. No new upstream changes are imported.
Evidence: `restart-evidence/20261019-head-last-mu-child/`.

## Exact branch decomposition

`SourceCurrentRecursiveHeadMuChildContexts.Suffix` contains start, literal
union-member selection and advance by actual Keeps. It has no explicit Mu
constructor. `Suffix.keeps` derives its actual cache interval.
`Suffix.literal` lifts the same full row to the suffix's starting value.

`chain` inducts on an actual RecursiveHeadChainRows.Chain. A start branch
has only a suffix. Each member or advance extends that suffix. A Mu step
selects its own actual stored unfold and starts a new suffix. The result
retains an actual prior Chain to that Mu and its exact entry, returned value
and return heap. It thus selects the last explicit Mu on this branch.

Advance effects can include Mu allocations from other collector branches.
The theorem does not select the last physical publication in the machine.
It gives no universal branch uniqueness and does not compare proof identities.

## Actual Head child producer

`head_child` starts from a completed Head, Ready, available closed input,
a selected full output row and the indexed selected child. It calls the
existing chronological Head-row producer. The output position and original
terminal-row index remain distinct. The terminal node supplies a literal Row.

The no-Mu alternative lifts that Row into the initial value. The Mu
alternative retains its selected prior Chain, actual unfold and explicit
suffix. The prefix's verified receipt derives the exact Mu-entry semantic
heap and availability. The suffix and final Head effects derive forward
growth into the final Head heap. The caller supplies physical publication
History from empty to that final heap. No History is inferred from Keeps.

The existing stored Mu child producer then derives the selected stored
writer and Child context for this exact full row and child index. Child
retains an original row in that stored body, exact fields and arity, an
indexed original child and its strict sizeOf bound. The output child is
either that original child or the result of its actual supported lexical
call, with its semantic, availability, replacement and issued-name facts.
The result bounds no generated child and identifies no current callback.

The selected stored body can itself be generated. This producer does not
trace it to the initial expression or prove a global recursive-call bound.

## Constructed check

The Nat/Bool source is `mu x. mu y. node7[x,y]`. Both binders use their
local reference. Actual first unfolding returns a used retained Mu.
Actual second unfolding supplies the selected ordinary row. The completed
Head and an explicit two-Mu Chain are derived from those actual calls.
Neither the initial value nor the first returned Mu has a literal row.
The selected child is child 1, the retained inner Mu.

The new Head producer therefore takes its Mu provenance alternative.
The check retains its chosen actual call, prior Chain, suffix, literal
returned row, stored writer and Child context. It does not identify a
unique chosen Mu with a separately named entry. It does not exclude all
Child identity alternatives for arbitrary chosen source bodies. The
fixture proves no complete outer reduction or Haskell behavior claim.

## Validation and remaining work

All five public declarations and one constructed endpoint pass complete
statement, proof and standard-axiom checks, with all eight printer settings.
Both selected strict logs are empty. The full default build passes 3473
jobs and 73958 axiom checks. Its only warning is the prior unused inputs
warning in InternedFreshOrdinaryClosedCompletion:24:5. Every heavy job uses
4294967296-byte memory.max and memory.high, zero swap and a five-minute cap.

Next derive original binding ancestry for the selected generated stored
body. Retain actual native call and writer chronology. Physical publication
History supplies no issued allocation Path or arbitrary writer-to-reader
issued suffix. Native memo receipts stay at their captured checked reader.
Do not assign native History to a later physical row-origin view.

A global renewal bound, active-owner exclusion, general outer completion,
convergence and concrete Haskell refinement remain open. The root-language
guarantee is unchanged. The full-library goal stays active.

Lean model. Under the stated guard conditions, its result represents
exactly the finite trees specified by its expression. A completed supported
modeled root reduction with empty inherited constraints preserves that
exact language.
The root theorem derives the logical startup cache and guard facts.
Field allocation, validity, guard coverage and numeric resources remain
explicit. General termination and Haskell correspondence remain open.
